payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Recover the missing reader-recovery phase implementation — bob-cli-q5.2.1.1 is closed but origin/master at 1c23bce7 has no snooze/read.rs or reconciliation snoozed recovery. The original transcript reports passing focused tests; saved completion file:explicit:37516ddfbf84314980ed8752 lists 14 uncommitted paths at base 19e7fe54. This phase will extract the shared reader needed for review exclusions; the land agent must recover or finish the missing direct recovery, preservation tests, and predecessor docs before closing the child epic.

Implementation contract for consumers: src/native/snooze/read.rs now exposes read(day_text, vault_relative_day_path, note_date, &SnoozeClock, &NoteIndex, &NoteTaskSettings, lookup) -> ReadView {rows: Vec<RowDetail {parsed, identity, title}>, classified: ClassifiedRows, identities: IdentityMap}. lookup returns cached Option<&str> by vault-relative path; parsed task notes are cached once per call. state::live_targets(&view.classified) supplies planned/blocked; planned_from_snapshot is a membership-only adapter with explicit Bob-zone today/note dates (membership does not depend on time-of-day). CLI evaluation uses this same reader. RowCtx/FreshnessRow/UnblockScope keep is_snoozed_today separate from is_today. Shared executable SP1-SP12/SP15 vectors are tests/fixtures/walks/planned-today.json; SP13 wake, SP14 placement, SP16 excess, SP17 seed are named Rust/CLI tests. docs/freshness.md and docs/walks.md publish the input/output contract. cargo check --tests passed before the final small cache/date-adapter refinements; focused executable tests and full gates still pending. No epic-symbol entries.

Verification update: just docs-check passed all implemented gates (lint, generated drift, strict build, URLs/links/tutorial and 447 documentation unit tests; 1 optional font-dependency test skipped). cargo check --tests passed; final formatting and diff checks pass. Full executable regression verification is being handed to a monitor, with implementation complete and only test/gate triage remaining. Baseline for clean-base comparisons is 1c23bce7. Do not infer the predecessor direct-recovery changes landed: the earlier proposed follow-up remains for the land agent; this phase owns the reader extraction and exclusions only.

Verification triage: implementation is committed as b8678657. Monitor 5rfve5sbzwpf passed freshness/snooze/task_complete/hooks unit tests and freshness CLI; just check passed format and Clippy but failed 43 lib tests and 56 CLI tests. The introduced SP vector assertion confused ignored-row reasons (ready/already_linked) with the CLI state ignored. Fixed SP4/SP5/SP9/SP15 fixtures to separate snooze_state and snooze_reason and added the reason assertion; all vector cases pass with the existing test binary after fixture correction. A fresh full gate plus clean-base 1c23bce7 lib/CLI comparison is next; no claim yet that the remaining 98 failures are unrelated. Existing leads are q9 (PDF kicker spacing), q4 (17 settle fixture failures), and ph.10/ph.8.1.6 (bold-only drawer fixture drift). No docs changed, so prior docs-check remains valid.

DISCOVERED ISSUE (bob-cli-q7 land): walks::snoozed_planned_today_vectors_agree_across_freshness_walks_and_plan fails deterministically on bob-cli master 8ee8d03c, both in full just check and alone (cargo test -p bob-obsidian --test cli -- walks::snoozed_planned_today_vectors..., 0.41s): tests/cli/walks.rs:746 SP4 expects state ready but the freshness row reports ignored (date 2026-11-17, jobs.md ^job, reason ready). The test arrived with b8678657 (SASE_BEAD bob-cli-q5.2.1.2), whose note #3 says full executable verification was still pending.
